name: TubeBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a tube coral structure. The object reveals the raw geometry of a tube coral — multiple thick, upright cylindrical tubes growing from a shared rounded base, each tube having a smooth surface and a slightly open hollow top. The tubes vary in height and angle slightly outward, creating a hand-like or bouquet arrangement. Without any texture or material color, the clean white geometry clearly shows the tubular form and the visible hollow openings at the top of each tube.
